name: alkane
description: Saturated hydrocarbon with only single C-C bonds; general formula CnH2n+2.

name: alkene
description: Hydrocarbon containing at least one C=C double bond; general formula CnH2n.

name: alkyne
description: Hydrocarbon containing at least one C≡C triple bond; general formula CnH2n-2.

name: alcohol
description: Organic compound with a hydroxyl (-OH) group bonded to a saturated carbon; general formula ROH.

name: ether
description: Organic compound with an oxygen bonded to two alkyl or aryl groups (R-O-R').

name: aldehyde
description: Organic compound with a carbonyl group (C=O) bonded to at least one hydrogen; general formula RCHO.

name: ketone
description: Organic compound with a carbonyl group (C=O) bonded to two carbon atoms; general formula RCOR'.

name: carboxylic acid
description: Organic compound with a carboxyl group (-COOH); general formula RCOOH.

name: ester
description: Organic compound derived from a carboxylic acid and an alcohol; general formula RCOOR'.

name: amide
description: Organic compound with a carbonyl bonded to a nitrogen; general formula RCONR'R''.

name: amine
description: Organic compound derived from ammonia by replacing one or more H atoms with carbon-containing groups.

name: nitrile
description: Organic compound with a cyano group (C≡N); general formula RCN.

name: nitro
description: Organic compound containing the nitro functional group (-NO2).

name: halide
description: Organic compound with a halogen (F, Cl, Br, I) bonded to a carbon atom; general formula RX.

name: thiol
description: Organic compound with a sulfhydryl group (-SH) bonded to a carbon; analogous to alcohols but with sulfur.

name: sulfide
description: Organic compound with two carbons bonded to a sulfur (thioether); general formula R-S-R'.

name: disulfide
description: Organic compound with two sulfur atoms bonded to each other (R-S-S-R').

name: phosphate ester
description: Organic compound with a phosphate group bonded through an oxygen (ROP(=O)(OH)2).

name: sulfate ester
description: Organic compound with a sulfate group bonded through an oxygen (RO-SO2-OH).

name: aromatic
description: Cyclic, planar compound with conjugated pi-electron system; benzene is the parent.

name: phenol
description: Aromatic compound with a hydroxyl group directly attached to the benzene ring.

name: enol
description: Alkene with a hydroxyl group on the vinylic carbon; tautomer of a ketone.

name: acid halide
description: Carboxylic acid derivative with the -OH replaced by a halogen (RCOX).

name: anhydride
description: Carboxylic acid derivative formed by condensation of two acid molecules with loss of water (RCOOCOR').

name: imine
description: Organic compound with a C=N double bond (R2C=NR').

name: enamine
description: Unsaturated amine: an amino group attached to a carbon of a C=C double bond.

name: azo
description: Organic compound with the functional group R-N=N-R', where R and R' are typically aryl groups.

name: hydrazone
description: Organic compound with the structure R2C=NNR'R''; derivative of hydrazine and a carbonyl.

name: peroxide
description: Organic compound with an oxygen-oxygen single bond (R-O-O-R').
